sloka: ललाटे भ्रुकुटीभिश्च सङ्गताभिर्व्यारोचत।युगान्ते सह नक्रैस्तु महोर्मिभिरिवोदधिः ।। ६.९३.१८ ।।
transliteration: lalāṭe bhrukuṭībhiśca saṅgatābhirvyārocata।yugānte saha nakraistu mahormibhirivodadhiḥ ।। 6.93.18 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's eyebrows contracted on his forehead, he shone like the waves in the great ocean with crocodiles at the time of dissolution of the universe.
